Follow, view or pay your rental contracts

xpath.attribute: (page_name == 'quote' or sale_order and sale_order.state in ('sent', 'cancel')) and not (sale_order and sale_order.is_spa)
(page_name == 'order' or sale_order and sale_order.state not in ('sent', 'cancel')) and not (sale_order and sale_order.is_spa)

template.name: Portal layout : rental contract menu entries

t.div: There are currently no sales contracts for your account.

div.t-if: sale_order.get_portal_last_transaction() and not invoices and sale_order.state in ('sent', 'sale') and portal_confirmation == 'pay' and not success and not error

t.t-value: True in [line.discount > 0 for line in sale_order.order_line]

tr.t-att-class: 'fw-bold o_line_section' if ( line.display_type == 'line_section' or line.product_type == 'combo' ) else 'fst-italic o_line_note' if line.display_type == 'line_note' else ''

tr.t-if: current_section and ( line_last or lines_to_report[line_index+1].display_type == 'line_section' or lines_to_report[line_index+1].product_type == 'combo' or ( line.combo_item_id and not lines_to_report[line_index+1].combo_item_id ) ) and not line.is_downpayment

span.t-att-class: ('text-success' if line.payment_state == 'paid' else 'text-warning' if line.payment_state in ('in_payment', 'partial') else 'text-danger' if line.payment_state == 'not_paid' else 'text-secondary')
('text-success' if line.payment_state == 'paid' else 'text-warning' if line.payment_state == 'in_process' else 'text-danger' if line.payment_state in ('canceled', 'rejected') else 'text-secondary')

div.t-attf-class: #{'col-3' if report_type != 'html' else 'col-sm-7 col-md-4'} ms-auto text-center

t.t: There are currently no rental contracts for your account.

span.t-att-class: ('text-success' if contract.unit_id.state == 'available' else 'text-info' if contract.unit_id.state == 'rented' else 'text-warning' if contract.unit_id.state in ('booked', 'maintenance') else 'text-danger' if contract.unit_id.state == 'sold' else 'text-secondary')
('text-success' if line.payment_status == 'paid' else 'text-warning' if line.payment_status in ('in_payment', 'partial') else 'text-danger' if line.payment_status == 'not_paid' else 'text-secondary')

('text-success' if line.payment_status in ('posted', 'paid') else 'text-warning' if line.payment_status in ('in_process', 'draft') else 'text-danger' if line.payment_status in ('canceled', 'rejected', 'cancel') else 'text-secondary')
